data.raw_provenance: Real MEAS:VOLT:DC? response captured on 2026-11-19 from GDM-8352 serial GEP848232, firmware 1.00, over USB CDC-ACM 2184:003b. The raw bytes are indexed in assets/fixtures/captures.jsonl. The reading is uncalibrated read-back, not a calibration certificate. The unit was re-tested later the same day (verify_all, 11:38:50Z); that evidence directory is git-ignored and is a local reference only.

support.hardware_verified_scope: Restricted to the eight observations listed below, from GDM-8352 serial GEP848232, firmware 1.00, USB CDC-ACM 2184:003b at /dev/ttyACM0, captured 2026-11-19 and re-tested later the same day (verify_all, 11:38:50Z; the evidence directory is git-ignored and local-only). The beeper write is silent; its state claim comes from the following SYST:BEEP:STAT? readback of No Beep. FUNC1? was observed returning VOLT and CURR but no raw bytes were preserved. All remaining documented commands are documented only.
known_limitations: *IDN?: raw identity captured; verification applies to one instrument.
MEAS:VOLT:DC?: raw response captured without a unit suffix; the unit comes from the command.
MEAS:CURR:DC?: raw response captured without a unit suffix; the unit comes from the command.
READ?: two fields captured; the second display's function and unit are UNVERIFIED.
SYST:BEEP:STAT?: only No Beep was captured; the other two texts are documented.

SYST:BEEP:STAT 0 / SYST:BEEP:STAT OFF: both accepted with no response; after SYST:BEEP:STAT 0 the following query still read No Beep, so the beeper is confirmed off. Silence alone is not evidence. This Skill refuses the setter.
FUNC1?: returned the current function, observed as VOLT and CURR; no raw bytes were preserved, other function markers are documented only, and the query is not implemented by this Skill.
SYST:ERR?: only the observed free text Command error is hardware-verified; no numbered error queue is established.
USB-TMC was not exercised; no function, range, or input-terminal switching was exercised, and terminal selection was not verified.
No accuracy or calibration was verified; no known input source was attached for a cross-check.
No AC voltage, AC current, 2-wire/4-wire resistance, frequency, period, capacitance, temperature, diode, continuity, or MEASure2 response was captured.
